name: Mobile Suit Gundam RE:0079
author: Sevchenko + GrayKitsune
description:
Changelog (0.3.3.7):
Radiator Fins gains Unique, can now mount on Mains
X-1 Methuss's Calibrated Weapon changed to: "When you build this mech or Rest, choose 1 Ranged Weapon. You may only fire this weapon 1/turn, but you may ignore the Heat (self), Overkill, and Ordnance of that weapon." (nerf)

Changelog (3.8):
Changes correctly applied

Changelog (3.9):
Icarus Frame Shift Drive is correctly placed back in Phoenix license, correctly marked as Free Action, and added Heat (self) and 1/round tag.

Changelog (4.0):
Methuss rebalance:
SP: 6 -> 7
Tech Attack: +1 -> -1
Armor: 1 -> 0
Trait added: Head-Mounted Display Tracking
Heavy -> Flex Mount
Calibrated Weapon's 1/turn limit removed 

Fixed GPU-9

Changelog (4.1):
Ringneck balance changes
Dumbfire: 
Remove +1 conditional accuracy
Enable CQB talents
Add Reliable 1

Lock-on:
May only supercombine 1/turn, maximum of 5
Impairs on a miss

Icarus Frame Shift Drive balance change
1/turn, you may perform any Protocol of your choice as a Free Action.
Added Unique tag

Added Gatling Lance (exotic)

X-1 balance changes
Reverted Heavy -> Flex mount change.

Changelog (4.2):
JAMRAAM SP cost removed

Changelog (5.0):
Adzam beta license
